name: act-aloha-sim-transfer-cube
benchmark_exclusion_reason: Robotics control-loop qualification uses the pinned recorded ALOHA replay contract rather than the generic inference benchmark catalog.

testcases.name: act-aloha-sim-transfer-cube-recorded-episode-0-frame-0
testcases.notes: Runs the native FP32 ACT graph on episode 0 frame 0 from the immutable LeRobot ALOHA transfer-cube recording, compares all 100x14 unnormalized actions with the exact training-source PyTorch policy, and emits the chunk at the recorded 50 Hz control frequency. Physical robot safety is explicitly outside this qualification.
